blocks.text: Buying a Home in Vedder Mountain, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Vedder Mountain

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Vedder Mountain Road south of the Vedder Bridge, Cultus Lake Road (Highway 202), and Gihlsen Road. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Vedder Mountain will find hillside single-family detached homes, rural view properties, custom houses on acreage and sloped lots, and river-side residential pockets near the base of the mountain. For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
Vedder Mountain Neighbourhood Guide

blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Vedder Mountain

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Vedder Mountain are served by SD33 South Side catchment schools including Vedder Elementary, Unsworth Elementary, Vedder Middle, G.W. Graham Secondary, and Sardis Secondary (confirm by street address on SD33 School Locator). Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Qoqó:lem (Vedder Mountain) Park and the Vedder Mountain trail network (hiking, trail running, and mountain biking), Vedder Park, and the Vedder River Rotary Trail. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 55 (Yarrow–Greendale loop via Vedder Mountain Road) and seasonal summer Route 56 (Cultus Lake).

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Vedder Mountain

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Vedder Mountain are regulated by City of Chilliwack Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland geotechnical and wildfire interface rules), Vedder River floodplain regulations along lower benches, and adjacent FVRD Electoral Area E/H plans. Before removing subjects on a property in Vedder Mountain, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our
BC Property Transfer Tax Calculator
and

What types of homes are for sale in Vedder Mountain?

Active MLS® listings in Vedder Mountain typically include hillside single-family detached homes, rural view properties, custom houses on acreage and sloped lots, and river-side residential pockets near the base of the mountain. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Vedder Mountain in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Vedder Mountain include SD33 South Side catchment schools including Vedder Elementary, Unsworth Elementary, Vedder Middle, G.W. Graham Secondary, and Sardis Secondary (confirm by street address on SD33 School Locator). Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Vedder Mountain?

Residents of Vedder Mountain have access to Qoqó:lem (Vedder Mountain) Park and the Vedder Mountain trail network (hiking, trail running, and mountain biking), Vedder Park, and the Vedder River Rotary Trail. See our
Vedder Mountain Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Vedder Mountain?

Key road corridors serving Vedder Mountain include Vedder Mountain Road south of the Vedder Bridge, Cultus Lake Road (Highway 202), and Gihlsen Road. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 55 (Yarrow–Greendale loop via Vedder Mountain Road) and seasonal summer Route 56 (Cultus Lake).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Vedder Mountain?

Properties in Vedder Mountain are governed by City of Chilliwack Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland geotechnical and wildfire interface rules), Vedder River floodplain regulations along lower benches, and adjacent FVRD Electoral Area E/H plans. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Vedder Mountain freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Vedder Mountain are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
